allow: Shell(powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'test-output.txt') { Get-Content 'test-output.txt' -Tail 5 } else { Write-Output 'no file yet' }")
Shell(powershell -Command "$env:CI='true'; npx vitest run *> test-output.txt; exit $LASTEXITCODE")
Shell(powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'test-output.txt') { Get-Content 'test-output.txt' -Tail 2 | ForEach-Object { $_.Substring(0, [Math]::Min($_.Length, 200)) } } else { 'no output yet' }")
Shell(powershell -Command "$c = Get-Content 'test-output.txt' -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { 'len=' + $c.Length; $c.Substring([Math]::Max(0,$c.Length-300)) } else { 'no output yet' }")
Shell(powershell -Command "$c = Get-Content 'test-output.txt' -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { 'len=' + $c.Length; $c.Substring([Math]::Max(0,$c.Length-400)) } else { 'no output yet' }")
